capabilities: Group chores into needs doing, coming up, and later
Log completions, skips, and snoozes with undo
Show a short completion history strip per chore
Limit the daily list with Focus mode
extras: Chores are stored only in frontmatter (type: chore, every, done, days, rotate), so they stay readable in Properties, Bases, and Dataview without the plugin. Focus mode is stored per device and does not sync; holiday dates live in plugin settings. Stated limits: no reminders or notifications outside Obsidian, history trimmed to about a dozen entries, no per-completion notes, interval changes not recorded, calendar chores repeat in weeks only, and long-press for the row menu has only been tested in Obsidian's mobile emulation.
motivation: The author wanted to know when a chore was last done to tell whether it needs doing again, since jobs like descaling the kettle only need doing every few months.
problem: Household chores have no hard deadline and repeat forever, so a normal task manager does not show when a chore was last done or whether it is due again.
summary: Recurring-chore tracker that keeps each chore as a note with interval and completion dates, and shows what is due, coming up, or on hold.
